message: The Today widget now keeps up while the app is closed. A task you deferred appears on the widget when it’s due, the day turns over at your day start time, and a widget that hasn’t updated in two days asks you to open the app instead of showing an old list. Daily targets show their count (3/8), and checking one off on the widget logs one unit instead of finishing the whole target. The small widget also says how many more tasks didn’t fit.
